newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won closes slightly lower in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won closes slightly lower in slow trading.

text.p: The won closed slightly lower on Tuesday, but its drop was limited by fears that a sharp fall could spark the central bank's intervention, dealers said.
The won ended at 843.40 after opening the day at an intra-day high of 842.30. It touched a low of 843.60.
Dealers said the sentiment towards the dollar remained strong as the on-going export slump is expected to continue for the time being.
"There is a strong dollar buying interest at around the 842 won level, but dealers abstained from actively buying due to fears of an intervention," said a dealer.
Dealers have said the Bank of Korea repeatedly sold a heavy amount of dollars on Monday to slow the won's drop. This was denied by the central bank.
Trading was slow as commercial deals were relatively scanty, dealers said.
The won's base mid-rate for Wednesday was set at 843.10, compared with Tuesday's 844.00.
